map.为中和用量估算参考，实际以 GB/T 7573 水萃取 pH 实测为准，具体助剂: This serves as a reference for estimating the neutralising dosage; in practice follow the measured water-extract pH per GB/T 7573, and combine the specific additive concentration and temperature with the on-site process.
map.为什么布面 pH 要控制？: Why must fabric pH be controlled?
map.冰醋酸和纯碱分别用于什么情况？: What are glacial acetic acid and soda ash each used for?
map.后整理前 pH 调节：确保布面 pH 落在安全范围（通常 4.0~7.5 视产品: pH adjustment before finishing: keep the fabric pH within the safe range (typically 4.0~7.5 depending on the product) to avoid fibre damage or skin irritation.
map.布面 pH 异常排查：pH 偏离时反推前处理净洗或酸中和工序是否到位。: Troubleshooting abnormal fabric pH: when pH drifts, work back to see whether the scouring or acid-neutralising step of the pretreatment was adequate.
map.布面 pH 调节计算器，输入当前 pH、目标 pH 与布重估算酸/碱调节剂用量，: Fabric pH adjustment calculator: enter the current pH, the target pH and the fabric weight to estimate the acid or alkali adjuster dosage, helping dyeing and finishing pretreatment.
map.布面偏碱用冰醋酸（或稀酸）下调；若因前处理过度酸洗导致偏酸，则用纯碱回调。工具按: If the fabric is on the alkaline side, lower it with glacial acetic acid (or dilute acid); if it is acidic because the pretreatment over-acid-washed, bring it back with soda ash. The tool decides the direction automatically from the difference between the current and target pH.
map.染整后残余碱剂使布面 pH 偏高，长期影响色光、手感与后整理助剂效果，贴身纺织品: Residual alkali after dyeing and finishing raises the fabric pH, which over time affects shade, handle and the performance of finishing auxiliaries, and next-to-skin textiles may irritate the skin, so it must be neutralised into the standard range.
map.染色后中和处理：活性/直接染料皂洗后布面偏碱，估算冰醋酸用量回调至中性附近。: Neutralisation after dyeing: reactive and direct dyes leave the fabric alkaline after soaping, so estimate the glacial acetic acid dosage to bring it back near neutral.
map.结果能直接用于大货吗？: Can the result be used directly for a large order?
map.：布重 200 g、当前 pH 9.5、目标 pH 7.0，工具按冰醋酸中和曲线: : with a fabric weight of 200 g, a current pH of 9.5 and a target of 7.0, the tool estimates about 0.6% (of the fabric weight) diluted glacial acetic acid along the neutralisation curve; after adjustment, retesting and getting pH between 6.8 and 7.2 meets the standard.
